usageNotes: Use this to register a new cluster-wide directory mapping that abstracts host-specific local paths behind a shared identifier — required before you can reference the mapping in storage or VM configurations. The caller must hold `Mapping.Modify` on `/mapping/dir`. The `map` array must contain at least one node-to-path entry; the mapping ID (`id`) must be a valid PVE config identifier (alphanumeric plus hyphens/underscores, no spaces).

examples.summary: Create a directory mapping for a shared ISO store path that differs by node

tips: The mapping ID must follow pve-configid format: start with a letter, use only [A-Za-z0-9_-], max 64 chars.
Each entry in `map` is a string in `node=<nodename>,path=<absolute-path>` format; every cluster node you want covered needs its own entry.
Returns null on success — confirm creation with get_cluster_mapping_dir or list_cluster_mapping_dir.
Directory mappings are cluster-wide metadata; the underlying path must exist on each referenced node independently.
